subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Measuring Ethical Culture
description: A short lesson to help you apply Measuring Ethical Culture.

hook.text: Can you measure culture? Yes. Anonymous surveys, hotline trends, exit interviews, and audit findings all tell a story.

buildup.text: Culture measurement combines quantitative data — report rates, resolution times — with qualitative employee feedback.

discovery.text: The Ethics & Compliance Initiative found that only 21% of employees believe their company has a strong ethical culture.

twist.text: Companies that measure culture regularly detect problems earlier. Those that don't are surprised by scandals.

climax.text: You manage what you measure. If you don't measure culture, you can't improve it.

punchline.text: Only 21% see strong culture. Measure it to improve it.

quiz.question: What percentage of employees believe their company has a strong ethical culture?
